findings.message: Catching every exception in this `@contextmanager` generator without re-raising suppresses errors from the caller's `with` block and from `commit()`. Failed writes are silently discarded while callers carry on as if they succeeded, so data is lost with no error reported. The explicit rollback is also gone.
This changes error-handling behaviour of `connect()` (exceptions are now suppressed), but the pull request adds no test covering it.
